description: This file implements string escaping functions used in build systems, handling various escaping modes for different platforms and contexts, including Ninja build files, shell commands, and Windows command line arguments.

classes.name: StackOrHeapBuffer
classes.description: A helper class that allocates a small buffer on the stack or on the heap if larger size is needed for string escaping operations.

methods.name: EscapeString
methods.description: Escapes a string according to specified options and returns the escaped string.

methods.name: EscapeStringToStream
methods.description: Writes the escaped version of a string to an output stream.

methods.name: EscapeJSONStringToStream
methods.description: Escapes a string as a JSON string and writes it to an output stream.
